en.title: Some 60 Ships Passed Through Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday, US Official Says
en.summary: A US official reported that approximately 60 ships transited through the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday.

en.title: US Senate Rejects Resolution to Halt the Iran War as Gas Prices Upend Midterms
en.summary: The US Senate rejected a resolution aimed at halting military action against Iran, with gas price fluctuations affecting midterm election discussions.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia calls for Gaza recovery, unobstructed humanitarian access

en.title: Saudi Arabia calls for Gaza recovery, unobstructed humanitarian access
en.summary: Saudi Arabia urged accelerated recovery efforts in Gaza and unrestricted humanitarian assistance ahead of winter, while calling for full implementation of ceasefire and reconstruction phases. A Saudi special envoy represented the Kingdom at a New York peace roundtable.

stories.title: Saudi ambassador presents letters of credence to Swedish king

en.title: Saudi ambassador presents letters of credence to Swedish king
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's new ambassador to Sweden presented her credentials to King Carl XVI Gustaf. The ambassador conveyed greetings from Saudi leadership and discussed strengthening bilateral relations and cooperation.

stories.title: US official: 60 ships passed through Strait of Hormuz in one day

en.title: US official: 60 ships passed through Strait of Hormuz in one day
en.summary: Approximately 60 commercial vessels transited the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday, carrying the highest daily crude oil volume since early July. About 40 vessels coordinated with US military forces for protection during passage.

stories.title: Senate rejects resolution to halt the Iran war as gas prices upend midterms

en.title: Senate rejects resolution to halt the Iran war as gas prices upend midterms
en.summary: The US Senate narrowly rejected a war powers resolution to stop military action against Iran, voting 49-50. Rising gas prices linked to the conflict have become a significant issue in midterm election politics.

en.summary: The Insurance Authority suspended Allied Cooperative Insurance Group from issuing comprehensive motor insurance policies effective September 24, 2026, following regulatory violations.

en.summary: Canadian Medical Center Co.'s board withdrew its recommendation for a capital increase through bonus share issuance and will reconsider the proposal after reviewing 2026 financial statements.

stories.title: ‎CMA seeks public input on algorithmic trading restrictions

en.title: CMA seeks public input on algorithmic trading restrictions
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Capital Market Authority is requesting feedback from market participants on proposed regulatory provisions for algorithmic trading. The 30-day consultation period ends October 24, 2026, with the aim of enhancing market integrity and efficiency while preventing disruption.
